_comment: A4 namespace spec: sh2.* runtime namespace + purity (mirrors shir_json.rs call_purity + shir.rs SYNC_BUILTINS). Frontends derive from this file; the Rust side must match (consistency test in sh2perl). The full per-call purity table (call_purity) has more entries than SYNC_BUILTINS (getVar→Emulable, fs.*→Fs, control signals, etc.) — the SYNC_BUILTINS list is the 'exec(cmd in SYNC_BUILTINS → Emulable) subset used by the exec purity arm.
